verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a split-inbox or priority-stream feature that sorts mail into important, team, newsletter, or calendar-invite streams for triage. The closest items are adjacent features: team inboxes and tailored team spaces, which are collaboration features, and rules and labels, which are building blocks a user would have to configure. None of these is documented as the focused-stream triage capability itself.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
